people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’ ”
translations.bsb: But Balaam replied, “Did I not tell you that whatever the LORD says, I must do?”
translations.kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
translations.asv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that Jehovah speaketh, that I must do?
